summary: Macros now read the DFM Notes tab as it is on screen, so a Notes preview compares against unsaved notes instead of the last saved copy.
details: The DFM assistant/macro context payload carries the live Notes tab text, and active_dfm.notes is seeded from it instead of falling back to the persisted output sidecar.
A macro that never calls update_notes() still leaves the Notes tab untouched, and editing Notes while a macro runs invalidates its captured context as before.
